rappel_detail.anchor: natural anchor on the summit block; bring slings
rappel_detail.station: Mount Clark's summit block, above the exposed Class 3-4 slot on the north face.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel of about 60 ft that many parties rig to skip the exposed downclimb of the corkscrew crux. Then descend the loose gully to the east ledge.
